versos.hebraico: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃
הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל־תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃

controles.web: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
controles.kjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
controles.livre: Deus, inclina os teus ouvidos à minha oração; e não te escondas de minha súplica.

versos.hebraico: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃

controles.web: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
controles.kjv: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
controles.livre: Presta atenção em mim, e responde-me; clamo por meu sofrimento, e grito,

versos.hebraico: מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי־יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃

controles.web: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
controles.kjv: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
controles.livre: Por causa da voz do inimigo, e pela opressão do perverso; porque me preparam suas maldades, e com furor eles me odeiam.

versos.hebraico: לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃

controles.web: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
controles.kjv: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
controles.livre: Meu coração sofre dores em meu interior, e terrores de morte caíram sobre mim.

versos.hebraico: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת׃

controles.web: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
controles.kjv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
controles.livre: Temor e tremor vêm sobre mim, e o horror me toma por completo.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי־יִתֶּן־לִּ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה׃

controles.web: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
controles.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
controles.livre: Então eu digo: Ah, quem me dera se eu tivesse asas como uma pomba! Eu voaria, e pousaria.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
controles.kjv: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
controles.livre: Eis que eu fugiria para longe, e ficaria no deserto. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
controles.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
controles.livre: Eu me apressaria para escapar do vento violento e da tempestade.

versos.hebraico: בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָי פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי־רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר׃

controles.web: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
controles.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
controles.livre: Devora-os, Senhor, divide a língua deles; porque tenho visto violência e briga na cidade.

versos.hebraico: יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
controles.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
controles.livre: Dia e noite cercam sobre seus muros; perversidade e opressão há dentro dela.

versos.hebraico: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ וְֽלֹא־יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
controles.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
controles.livre: Coisas destrutivas estão dentro dela; e a falsidade e o engano não sai de suas praças.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא־מְ֭שַׂנְאִי עָלַ֣י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
controles.kjv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
controles.livre: Porque não é um inimigo o que me insulta, pois se fosse eu o suportaria; nem é alguém que me odeia o que se engrandece contra mim, pois se fosse eu me esconderia dele.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּֽעִי׃

controles.web: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
controles.kjv: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
controles.livre: Mas és tu, homem semelhante a mim; meu guia, e meu conhecido;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃

controles.web: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
controles.kjv: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
controles.livre: Que juntos agradavelmente dávamos conselhos um ao outro ; na casa de Deus andávamos entre a multidão.

versos.hebraico: ישימות עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי־רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃

controles.web: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in their midst.
controles.kjv: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
controles.livre: Que a morte os tome de surpresa, e desçam ao mundo dos mortos ainda vivos; porque maldades há na morada deles, e no interior de cada um deles.

versos.hebraico: אֲ֭נִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
controles.kjv: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.
controles.livre: Eu clamarei a Deus, e o SENHOR me salvará.

versos.hebraico: עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי׃

controles.web: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
controles.kjv: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
controles.livre: À tarde, e pela manhã, e ao meio dia, orarei e clamarei; e ele ouvirá a minha voz.

versos.hebraico: פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־לִ֑י כִּֽי־בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
controles.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
controles.livre: Ele resgatou em paz a minha alma da batalha que havia contra mim; porque muitos vieram para me prejudicar .

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁמַ֤ע׀ אֵ֨ל׀ וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah.   They never change, who don’t fear God.
controles.kjv: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
controles.livre: Deus ouvirá, e os humilhará, ele que governa desde os princípios dos tempos. (Selá)Porque eles não mudam de comportamento , nem temem a Deus.

versos.hebraico: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
controles.kjv: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
controles.livre: Meu antigo amigo se voltou contra os que tinham paz com ele, e violou seu pacto.

versos.hebraico: חָלְק֤וּ׀ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקֲרָב־לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
controles.kjv: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
controles.livre: Sua boca é agradável como a manteiga, mas seu coração deseja a guerra; suas palavras parecem mais suaves que o azeite, mas são espadas prontas para o ataque.

versos.hebraico: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃

controles.web: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
controles.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
controles.livre: Entrega tuas preocupações ao SENHOR, e ele te sustentará; ele não permitirá que o justo fique caído para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם׀ לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח־בָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
controles.kjv: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
controles.livre: Porém tu, SENHOR, farás com que eles desçam ao poço da perdição; os homens sanguinários e enganadores não viverão a metade de seus dias; e eu confiarei em ti.
